name: Rhododendron forests, thickets and heaths
status: 5 archetypal species (full list archived in docs/plant_archive)
notes: Over 1,000 species exist; these form landscapes: Himalayan red forests, Appalachian hells and balds, Black Sea understory, alpenrose heath, Siberian dahurica, Yunnan giants, arctic dwarfs, tropical epiphytic vireyas. Bee- and bird-pollinated; nectar toxic (mad honey). Acid soil: peat and granite, absent on limestone.

canopy.name: Tree rhododendron
canopy.source: Himalaya and S Indian hills; forest-forming; Blood-red blossom forests of Nepal and Sikkim. Kew POWO; standard floras.

traits.leaf_shape: simple or compound broad leaves, most deciduous in cold bands
traits.trunk: single trunk dividing into a rounded crown
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: red-brown to pinkish bark, rough, peeling and shredding in thin flakes and strips; old trunks gnarled

leaf.notes: leathery oblong-lance leaves, dark green above, underside silvery to cinnamon-fawn felted; in whorls at shoot tips

flower.form: dense rounded trusses 10-15 cm of 15-20 bell flowers, blood red (pink or white at altitude), dark nectar pouches

fruit.form: brown woody capsules 2-4 cm in clusters

appearance.seasonal: evergreen; whole hillsides scarlet in March-April
appearance.silhouette: a gnarled small tree 10-20 m with a rounded dense dark crown; in flower a dome of red; forest-forming on Himalayan ridges
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Rhododendron arboreum; Flora of China; Trees and Shrubs Online

canopy.name: Big-leaf rhododendron
canopy.source: Yunnan-Burma cloud forest; Leaves to a metre long. Kew POWO; standard floras.

traits.leaf_shape: simple or compound broad leaves, most deciduous in cold bands
traits.trunk: single trunk dividing into a rounded crown
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: grey-brown, rough, flaking in patches; stout branches

leaf.notes: enormous glossy dark green oblong leaves up to 1 m with a pale silvery-fawn suede underside and bold pale midrib; in huge whorls

flower.form: big trusses 20-30 cm of 20-30 creamy-yellow bells each with a crimson blotch at the base

appearance.silhouette: a coarse open small tree 6-12 m whose giant glossy leaves in whorls read like a rubber plant in the cloud forest
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Rhododendron sinogrande; Flora of China; Trees and Shrubs Online

shrub.name: Great rhododendron
shrub.source: Appalachian coves and stream banks; Rhododendron hells under hemlock. Kew POWO; standard floras.

traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: red-brown to grey-brown, thin, scaly; crooked sprawling stems

leaf.notes: long leathery dark green oblong leaves, paler beneath; whorled; curl into tubes and droop in freezing cold

flower.form: compact trusses of pale pink to white bells with olive-green spotting, June-July

appearance.seasonal: evergreen; leaves droop and roll below freezing
appearance.silhouette: impenetrable thickets ('hells') of sprawling crooked stems 3-6 m under hemlock; a dark glossy tangle along streams
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Rhododendron maximum; Flora of North America; USFS

shrub.name: Alpenrose
shrub.source: Alps subalpine; Heath above the trees. Kew POWO; standard floras.

traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: grey-brown thin scaly bark on wiry low stems

leaf.notes: small glossy dark green elliptic leaves, edges rolled under, underside densely rusty-brown scaly (ferrugineum)

flower.form: clusters of 6-10 small bell flowers, deep rose-pink to crimson, June-July

appearance.seasonal: evergreen; slopes pink in early summer
appearance.silhouette: a knee-high (0.5-1 m) dense evergreen heath mat above the treeline, dotted pink in bloom
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Rhododendron ferrugineum; Flora Europaea; Kew POWO

epiphyte.name: Vireya rhododendron
epiphyte.source: Malesian montane forest, epiphytic; Tropical epiphytic rhododendrons. Kew POWO; standard floras.

traits.leaf_shape: strap or rosette leaves in a clump on a branch
traits.note: leaf/trunk/petiole derived from the plant's shape class; per-species detail where the entry carries it (aroids, cannabis)

bark.notes: grey-brown, thin, smooth; slender branches with scaly young shoots

leaf.notes: elliptic to lance leaves in pseudo-whorls, mid to dark green, minutely scaly beneath; leathery

flower.form: trusses of 5-12 funnel/trumpet flowers 4-6 cm, bright orange to orange-yellow (red or bicolour in Philippine forms), waxy

fruit.form: narrow brown capsules 2-5 cm, seeds with tails

appearance.seasonal: evergreen; flowers off and on all year
appearance.silhouette: a loose shrub 1-5 m perched on mossy branches or on the ground in montane forest; glowing orange trumpets against dark leaves
appearance.refs: Wikipedia Rhododendron javanicum; Trees and Shrubs Online; Kew POWO
